name: Mortgage Ezy

funder: Mortgage Ezy is a mortgage manager that describes itself as having become 'a fully securitised lender'; individual wholesale funders behind each Solution are not named on the public site.

assessmentBufferPct.note: Not published. Mortgage Ezy's Solution Guides and servicing calculators sit behind the partners.mezybroker.com.au broker login; the public 'Mezy Solutions' page shows 'You are not logged in' and lists product names only.

dtiCap.note: No DTI cap is published. One product goes the other way: the Propel Lo Doc Jumbo is advertised with 'No DTI, CCR or Credit Score'.

gaps: Mortgage Ezy's Solution Guides — the documents that actually hold the policy — are behind the partners.mezybroker.com.au broker login. The public 'Mezy Solutions' page renders as 'You are not logged in' and lists product names with one-line descriptions only. Everything recorded here comes from the four public Featured Products tiles.
No servicing policy: no assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, HEM basis, rental shading or credit-card assessment rate.
No full-doc maximum LVR, no minimum loan amount, no employment tenure rules, no income-type table, no credit-history criteria and no security/postcode policy are published.
The Expat and Non Resident solutions exist publicly but carry no published LVR, accepted-country, accepted-currency or foreign-income-shading terms.

Only four products are advertised publicly (Ezy SMSF Fee Waiver Special, Propel Ezy Vacant Land, Propel Lo Doc Jumbo, Ezy Lo Doc Accountants Dec) out of nine named solutions — the Full Doc, Expat, Non Resident, Construction, Alt Doc, Non Conforming and Commercial products have no public figures at all.

An older public SMSF Solution Guide exists (mezybroker.com.au/wp-content/uploads/openforms/MEZY_Solution-Guide_SMSF_20220912_reduced.pdf, dated 12 September 2022) but was NOT used — at nearly four years old it would be stale and is contradicted by the current 70% SMSF LVR tile.

ABN not recorded: a Mortgage Ezy SMSF application form on the site shows 'ABN : 56 606 554 321' but the site footer names the credit licensee as 'Mezy Assets Pty Ltd T/A Mortgage Ezy ACL 494807' without an ABN, and the two could not be tied together from a public source.

Source pages (mezybroker.com.au) sit behind a bot filter that returns HTTP 403 to any automated client, so scripts/check-lender-sources.mjs cannot re-verify them on a schedule. Both URLs were opened and confirmed live by hand on 2026-07-29; treat the values as needing a manual re-check rather than an automated one.
